senses.gloss: ch. sameto count, mark, write, v. סַפְרָא I. I.

units: Targ. Job I, 20 (Ms. סְפַר Pe.).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 13:33">Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 33</cite> (not <he>יַסְפֵּר</he>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 14:8">ib. XIV, 8</cite>, sq. (h. text <he>גלח</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:1">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>יתיב ומְסַפֵּר ליה</he> (Haman) sat down and cut his (Mordecai’s) hair; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:1">ib.</cite> <he>מן דחסל</he> (<he>מן</he>) <he>מְסַפְּרָא ליה</he> when he had done cutting his hair; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְסַפֵּר</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אית בר נש … ולא מ׳</he> is there a man who putts the royal crown on his head without having his hair cut?; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:4">Esth. R. to VI, 10</cite>.
